The core tension: HyDE removal improved stability but may have sacrificed query coverage for rare/technical terms; disabled reasoning reduced inference errors but left numerics and subtle comparisons exposed.

A secondary cluster is refused on bridge questions (3 failures), indicating the compressor or generator discards evidence even when spans are present. Retrieval_miss on extraction questions (2 failures) and retrieval_partial on multi-hop bridge/numeric questions (4 failures) show ranking fragility when HyDE produces query-drift.
